services.name: Discover Cruises
services.desc: Travel through forest and volcanic landscapes to Lake Taupō, New Zealand’s largest lake. Cruise across its waters to see the impressive Māori rock carvings at Mine Bay. Following lunch, return to Rotorua for free time and dinner at a local restaurant. Overnight in Rotorua. (B,L,D) View image

services.name: Day 7 Whale Watching In Akureyri
services.desc: Savor the fish that took Iceland from poverty to prosperity at the Herring Era Museum, where you’ll have a herring tasting. Belly full of this Icelandic staple, take to the sea for a whale watching tour off the north coast! Keep your eyes peeled for magnificent creatures breaking the surface of the Arctic waters.

includes: Radically all-inclusive travel with door-to-door service
blurb: Approach Tours offers multi-day group tours to various international destinations, focusing on immersive cultural and natural experiences. Tours range from 13 to 20 days and include destinations such as Australia, Antarctica, Ecuador, France, Costa Rica, Iceland, New Zealand, Spain, Japan, and Thailand. The company emphasizes all-inclusive travel with door-to-door service and comfort.
